2.
Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. The present criminal revision under Section 438/442 of BNSS is moved on behalf of the Revisionist against the impugned order dated 08.02.2024 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun in Case No.2334 of 2023, titled as "State vs. Rajpal Walia" under Sections 420, 406 & 120-B of IPC, P.S. Dalanwala, District Dehradun, whereby the learned court below has partly allowed the application under Section 239 of Cr.P.C. filed by the Revisionist and has framed charges for the offence under Sections 420 & 120-B of IPC.
4. Learned counsel for the Revisionist has filed the Delay Condonation Application (IA No.1 of 2024) to condone the delay of 222 days in filing the present revision.

5. Learned counsel for the Revisionist appeared through V.C. explained the delay that he was in custody for more than a year in a PMLA case and thereafter only when he was enlarged on interim bail, he could file for his rights.
6. Learned counsel for the Respondents strongly opposes the said delay and submits there is no valid ground to condone the delay.

7. However, in the interest of justice, the delay is hereby condoned subject to the payment of cost of `5000/- to be deposited with the Advocate Welfare Fund maintained by Uttarakhand High Court Bar Association, within one week from today.
8. Accordingly, the Delay Condonation Application would stand allowed.

11. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
